<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission oversight:</strong> While the ECI concluded a national conference with state commissioners, opposition parties continue to stage local and national protests, accusing the body of undermining democratic rights.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP campaign strategy:</strong> As the opposition focuses on institutional protests, the BJP is countering with criticism of opposition tactics and launching civic election manifestos, such as in Gandhinagar.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a></span></li>
